evaluation_dataset: merged PR #8472 blinded V39 fixed-yellow-cue recheck, 36-frame frozen sample; labels remain unchanged
input_episode: map01-v39-coast-liveness-live-01; episode source controller commit is not pinned in the retained run

candidate_rule.yellow_pixel: R>180 and G>100 and B<100 and R>0.8*G and G>1.5*B
candidate_rule.positive: at least one component has area >= 8 pixels

baseline: published fixed yellow pixel count >200; reported TP=3 FP=0 FN=13 TN=18; uncertain=2 excluded
decision_rule: This is a posthoc exploratory comparison because the labels were fetched and visible before the candidate rule was authored. Do not call it blinded or preregistered; do not tune further or claim general detector performance from one episode.
limits: one episode and one reviewer label set
fixed ROI/color mask can confuse enemy sprites with blood, projectiles, and animation
no live input, interruption, release, recovery, game progress, or terminal outcome
